gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
I can't figure ___ how this app works.
I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.
